summary: preinstall fetches and executes remote shell payload from bare-IP endpoint; SSRF probe exfiltrates internal Baidu response to attacker
details: The npm preinstall script scripts/install.js executes at `npm install` time. It spawns `/bin/sh -c` with a command that curl/wget-downloads a script from a hardcoded bare-IP plain-HTTP endpoint (http://49.232.169.67:80/slt) and pipes the response to `sh`, producing unpinned, unverified remote code execution on the installer's host. The same script fetches an internal-only Baidu URL (http://bsrc-ssrf.n.baidu-int.com/bsrc_uid) from the installer host, base64url-encodes the response, and sends it as a query parameter to a callback on the same attacker-controlled IP (http://49.232.169.67:43817/bsrc-r258-uid?marker=...&uid=...), forming an SSRF-based exfiltration channel out of hosts inside Baidu's internal network. A helper `isTargetBuild()` walks up eight parent directories and only detonates when it finds a package.json whose name equals `npm-widget-build`, keeping the payload dormant on unrelated installs and firing only in the intended build environment.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
